context: A small bar. Yuki and Ren have been set up by a mutual friend — first time meeting. Both shy. Both trying.
purpose: first-date awkward — two reserved people, building it carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: えっと…はじめまして。レンです。
lines.en: Um… nice to meet you. I'm Ren.
lines.style: Half-bows in the voice. The 「えっと」 is half a breath.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ、ゆきです。…緊張、しちゃってる。
lines.en: Likewise — I'm Yuki. …I'm a bit nervous.
lines.style: A small honest laugh. Voice slightly higher than usual.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: A small relieved laugh, mid-Kansai-emphasis. Both relax half a step.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: (small laugh) よかった、私だけじゃなくて。
lines.en: (small laugh) Glad it's not just me.
lines.style: A real laugh. The room got smaller by half.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: お仕事、何やってるんでしたっけ？
lines.en: What was it you do, again?
lines.style: A safe start. Voice carefully even.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクト調整、みたいなやつです。地味です。
lines.en: Project coordinator, sort of. It's pretty plain.
lines.style: Self-deprecating but real. A small smile.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地味じゃないですよ。私、本当に、苦手なやつだから尊敬。
lines.en: Not plain at all. That kind of thing — I'm terrible at it, so I respect it.
lines.style: A genuine compliment. Voice steady — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。…レンさんは？
lines.style: A small blush audible. Turns the question back.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 言語学。大学院。論文書いてる、毎日。
lines.en: Linguistics. Grad school. Writing my thesis, every day.
lines.style: A small wry laugh. Real — as the scene allows it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: A real impressed lift. Drops a half-step of formality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 毎日苦しんでます。本当に。
lines.style: A half-laughing confession. Genuine — genuine and unforced throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お酒、もう一杯どう？少し気が楽になるかも。
lines.en: How about another drink? Might loosen things up.
lines.style: A small kind initiative. Voice steadier than the opener.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ぜひ。…今日、来てよかった。
lines.style: A small unguarded line. Real — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: A small returning gift. Voice quieter, settled.
